list.name: indicator
list.label: Indicator
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT v.indicator_code AS __value, i.name AS __text FROM v_indicator_values v JOIN indicator i ON i.code = v.indicator_code WHERE v.obs_type = 'forecast' ORDER BY 2
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT v.indicator_code AS __value, i.name AS __text FROM v_indicator_values v JOIN indicator i ON i.code = v.indicator_code WHERE v.obs_type = 'forecast' ORDER BY 2

list.name: geo
list.label: Geography
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT geo FROM v_indicator_values WHERE indicator_code = '$indicator' AND obs_type = 'forecast' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT geo FROM v_indicator_values WHERE indicator_code = '$indicator' AND obs_type = 'forecast' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Actual outcome and forecasts by vintage
panels.description: Each forecast round (IMF WEO, European Commission AMECO) is kept as its own line. Forecast error appears once the outcome for a forecast year is published.

targets.rawSql: SELECT period::timestamptz AS time, value, 'actual: ' || source_code AS metric FROM v_indicator_values WHERE indicator_code = '$indicator' AND geo = '$geo' AND frequency = 'A' AND role IN ('benchmark') AND vintage = '' AND $__timeFilter(period) ORDER BY 1

SELECT period::timestamptz AS time, value, vintage AS metric FROM v_indicator_values WHERE indicator_code = '$indicator' AND geo = '$geo' AND frequency = 'A' AND vintage <> '' AND obs_type = 'forecast' AND $__timeFilter(period) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Forecast vs actual
panels.description: Error = forecast minus actual; positive values mean the forecast was too high.

targets.rawSql: SELECT period_label AS year, forecaster, vintage, round(forecast_value::numeric, 2) AS forecast, round(actual_value::numeric, 2) AS actual, round(forecast_error::numeric, 2) AS error, actual_source, actual_status FROM v_forecast_vs_actual WHERE indicator_code = '$indicator' AND geo = '$geo' ORDER BY period DESC, forecaster, vintage DESC

SELECT period_label AS year, forecaster, previous_vintage, vintage, round(value::numeric, 2) AS forecast, round(change_vs_previous_vintage::numeric, 2) AS revision FROM v_forecast_revisions WHERE indicator_code = '$indicator' AND geo = '$geo' AND previous_vintage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY vintage DESC, period
